name: Bloodthirsty Toy

stealth.details: (trained) to hear a child imitate an animal's roar

disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to handle the toy without disturbing it or DC 21 Occultism check (trained) to suppress the memories suffusing the toy

items.name: Chomp
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the toy

---

Effect The toy animates for a split second, biting the triggering creature with a ferocious jaws Strike.

text: A scruffy stuffed bear animates, biting whoever disturbs it.
